description: PRT Monthly On Time Performance by Route is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by Pittsburgh Regional Transit. This dataset contains the monthly average on time performance (OTP) percentage by route and service day type (weekday, Saturday, and Sunday/Holiday service). A vehicle is considered on time if it is no more than one minute early or five minutes late to a timepoint. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher Pittsburgh Regional Transit. Its tags are OTP, _etl, bus, calls for service, on time performance. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-06-09 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
